id: \bDid I notice you, or did you notice me?
en: \bDid I notice you, or did you notice me?
it: \bSono io che ho notato te o tu che hai notato me?

id: A very good battle, indeed.
en: A very good battle, indeed.
it: Davvero un'ottima lotta.

id: \bLet's have a rematch!
en: \bLet's have a rematch!
it: \bFacciamo la rivincita!

id: You beat me again!
en: You beat me again!
it: Mi hai battuto di nuovo!

id: \bI don't think I'll ever be able to beat you.
en: \bI don't think I'll ever be able to beat you.
it: \bNon credo che riuscirò mai a batterti.

id: \bI'll get even stronger, and beat you next time!
en: \bI'll get even stronger, and beat you next time!
it: \bDiventerò ancora più forte e la prossima volta ti batterò!

id: \bHi \PN! I'm your Rival!
en: \bHi \PN!  I'm your Rival!
it: \bCiao \PN! Sono il tuo Rivale!

id: \bDo you want to name me, or leave me with my default name as defined in trainers.txt?
en: \bDo you want to name me, or leave me with my default name as defined in trainers.txt?
it: \bVuoi darmi un nome o lasciarmi quello predefinito definito in trainers.txt?

id: \bSo my name is \v[12], huh? Okay then.
en: \bSo my name is \v[12], huh?  Okay then.
it: \bQuindi mi chiamo \v[12], eh? Va bene.

id: \bLet's get down to the battle!
en: \bLet's get down to the battle!
it: \bPassiamo alla lotta!

id: Not too shabby.
en: Not too shabby.
it: Niente male.

id: \bI'm going to leave now. Smell you later!
en: \bI'm going to leave now.  Smell you later!
it: \bOra me ne vado. Ci si vede!

id: \rYou'll need at least two Pokémon if you want to battle us.
en: \rYou'll need at least two Pokémon if you want to battle us.
it: \rTi servono almeno due Pokémon se vuoi sfidarci.

id: \rAh, looks like a challenging trainer. Ready, Bob?
en: \rAh, looks like a challenging trainer.  Ready, Bob?
it: \rAh, sembra un Allenatore impegnativo. Pronto, Bob?

id: Our teamwork failed!
en: Our teamwork failed!
it: Il nostro gioco di squadra ha fallito!

id: \rNotice that our events aren't created by comments.
en: \rNotice that our events aren't created by comments.
it: \rNota che i nostri eventi non sono creati tramite commenti.

id: Something unseeable is in the way. Want to use the Silph Scope?
en: Something unseeable is in the way.  Want to use the Silph Scope?
it: Qualcosa di invisibile blocca il passaggio. Vuoi usare la Spettrosonda?

id: The invisible Pokémon became completely visible!
en: The invisible Pokémon became completely visible!
it: Il Pokémon invisibile è diventato completamente visibile!

id: The startled Pokémon attacked!
en: The startled Pokémon attacked!
it: Il Pokémon, spaventato, ha attaccato!

id: Something unseeable is in the way. Want to use the Devon Scope?
en: Something unseeable is in the way.  Want to use the Devon Scope?
it: Qualcosa di invisibile blocca il passaggio. Vuoi usare il Devonscopio?

id: Something unseeable is in the way.
en: Something unseeable is in the way.
it: Qualcosa di invisibile blocca il passaggio.

id: \rBattle me now!
en: \rBattle me now!
it: \rSfidami subito!

id: Defeated! Oh my!
en: Defeated!  Oh my!
it: Sconfitta! Oh, cielo!

id: \rCan I add you to my contacts list?
en: \rCan I add you to my contacts list?
it: \rPosso aggiungerti alla mia lista contatti?

id: \rI'll say the same thing after every battle.
en: \rI'll say the same thing after every battle.
it: \rDirò la stessa cosa dopo ogni lotta.

id: \bYou'll need at least two Pokémon if you want to battle us.
en: \bYou'll need at least two Pokémon if you want to battle us.
it: \bTi servono almeno due Pokémon se vuoi sfidarci.

id: \bAh, looks like a challenging trainer. Ready, Alice?
en: \bAh, looks like a challenging trainer.  Ready, Alice?
it: \bAh, sembra un Allenatore impegnativo. Pronta, Alice?

id: \bNotice that our events aren't created by comments.
en: \bNotice that our events aren't created by comments.
it: \bNota che i nostri eventi non sono creati tramite commenti.

id: \rI've brought my own special backdrop!
en: \rI've brought my own special backdrop!
it: \rMi sono portata il mio sfondo speciale!

id: My Skitty!
en: My Skitty!
it: Il mio Skitty!

id: \rI battled you first because my event's number (7) comes before the Hiker's and Fisherman's event numbers.
en: \rI battled you first because my event's number (7) comes before the Hiker's and Fisherman's event numbers.
it: \rTi ho sfidato per prima perché il numero del mio evento (7) viene prima di quelli del Montanaro e del Pescatore.

id: \bDo you want to team up with me?
en: \bDo you want to team up with me?
it: \bVuoi fare squadra con me?

id: \PN teamed up with Brendan!\se[itemlevel]\wtnp[20]
en: \PN teamed up with Brendan!\se[itemlevel]\wtnp[20]
it: \PN ha fatto squadra con Brendan!\se[itemlevel]\wtnp[20]

id: \bOK then.
en: \bOK then.
it: \bOK, allora.

id: These are all the particle effects available in Essentials. An event can only have one particle effect.
en: These are all the particle effects available in Essentials.  An event can only have one particle effect.
it: Questi sono tutti gli effetti particellari disponibili in Essentials. Un evento può avere un solo effetto particellare.

id: Shadow sources can be modified as in the top left particle event.
en: Shadow sources can be modified as in the top left particle event.
it: Le fonti d'ombra possono essere modificate come nell'evento particellare in alto a sinistra.

id: All four parameters (anglemax, anglemin, maxdistance, opacity) must be included in that order if you want to change any of them.
en: All four parameters (anglemax, anglemin, maxdistance, opacity) must be included in that order if you want to change any of them.
it: Tutti e quattro i parametri (anglemax, anglemin, maxdistance, opacity) devono essere inclusi in quest'ordine se vuoi modificarne qualcuno.

id: The default values are "anglemax 0", "anglemin 0", "maxdistance 350", "opacity 100". Distance is in pixels.
en: The default values are "anglemax 0", "anglemin 0", "maxdistance 350", "opacity 100".  Distance is in pixels.
it: I valori predefiniti sono "anglemax 0", "anglemin 0", "maxdistance 350", "opacity 100". La distanza è in pixel.

id: The shadow-related comments must come before the particle effect comment.
en: The shadow-related comments must come before the particle effect comment.
it: I commenti relativi alle ombre devono precedere il commento dell'effetto particellare.

id: \bThis battle will go without a hitch!
en: \bThis battle will go without a hitch!
it: \bQuesta lotta andrà liscia come l'olio!

id: You're too good for me!
en: You're too good for me!
it: Sei troppo forte per me!

id: \bHow did you manage to face all three of us?
en: \bHow did you manage to face all three of us?
it: \bCome hai fatto ad affrontarci tutti e tre?

id: \bI'll get my tackle out for you!
en: \bI'll get my tackle out for you!
it: \bTiro fuori l'attrezzatura per te!

id: Washed out!
en: Washed out!
it: Che naufragio!

id: \bI don't understand why my Magikarp couldn't beat you.
en: \bI don't understand why my Magikarp couldn't beat you.
it: \bNon capisco perché il mio Magikarp non sia riuscito a batterti.

id: \bHi! I like shorts! They're comfy and easy to wear!
en: \bHi!  I like shorts!  They're comfy and easy to wear!
it: \bCiao! Adoro i pantaloncini! Sono comodi e facili da indossare!

id: Aww, I lost.
en: Aww, I lost.
it: Uffa, ho perso.

id: \bYou can't get a trainer event simpler than me!
en: \bYou can't get a trainer event simpler than me!
it: \bUn evento Allenatore più semplice di me non esiste!

id: \rGet ready for a double battle!
en: \rGet ready for a double battle!
it: \rPreparati a una lotta in doppio!

id: You didn't have to win so convincingly!
en: You didn't have to win so convincingly!
it: Non c'era bisogno di vincere in modo così netto!

id: \rMake sure all double battle opponents have at least 2 Pokémon!
en: \rMake sure all double battle opponents have at least 2 Pokémon!
it: \rAssicurati che tutti gli avversari delle lotte in doppio abbiano almeno 2 Pokémon!
